title: AeroVision: A Leakage-Audited Dataset and Corruption Benchmark for Robust Military Aircraft Identification (dataset labels, splits, code and results)
description: Code and dataset release (labels, splits and metadata; no images) for military-aircraft detection with affiliation labels: 12,881 images, 28 aircraft types, leakage-audited clean validation and test lists, the Aircraft-C corruption benchmark (9 corruptions x 3 severities), selective (abstaining) affiliation decisions, and all trained-model results. Images are not redistributed. Labels and metadata: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
